mechanism: Both drugs possess anticholinergic properties; ondansetron has weak anticholinergic activity that combines additively with oxybutynin's potent anticholinergic effects, increasing risk of anticholinergic toxicity.
action: Monitor patients for anticholinergic adverse effects (urinary retention, constipation, dry mouth, cognitive impairment); consider dose adjustment or alternative antiemetic if significant symptoms develop.
